title: Bag unseen-pickup registry (write-only)
oneLine: Session set of bag keys picked up but not inspected; still written each pickup, read by nothing since BagCompact went.
topConcern: Registry grows unbounded and re-renders BottomDashboard per pickup while no badge reads has/count/epoch.

title: Open Hero on a section deep link (heroSectionBus)
oneLine: One-shot pending request Hero consumes during render; no producer calls request() anywhere.
topConcern: Only live writer of laneClosed/selCat; a future caller revives three half-retired paths and setState-in-render.

title: Quest detail selection (questDetailBus)
oneLine: Which quest page the drill shows; null or stale ids render Quest not found or the done page.

title: Skill detail selection and open epoch (skillDetailBus)
oneLine: Open/consume epoch and persisted last-viewed skill; open() and selected() have no callers, only select() writes.
topConcern: Header promises a persisted outline and deep link that no longer exist.

title: Friend presence: online, grace, away, offline, last seen
oneLine: Per-friend presence from S.others with a 20 s in-memory grace and a localStorage last-seen map.
topConcern: bt_friendSeen never pruned; grace measured from the last render, not the peer's last tick.

title: Friends client store: doc, DM archive, unread, open thread, error slot, migration
oneLine: Client half of the friend request/accept/DM protocol in module vars and localStorage, archive for a delivered-once backlog.
topConcern: friend_error is stored but takeError has no caller, so every friend failure is silent; DMs the worker drops show as sent.

title: Friend portrait cache (pending/ready per friend)
oneLine: Per-friend {key,url,pending} portrait regenerated when the friend's look key changes.
topConcern: Unsequenced async race (the class v2.3.1835 fixed for your own portrait) can store an older look; heals next render.

title: Quest log and journal status mirror (offered, active, ready, done)
oneLine: Sheet derives each quest's status from rpg._quests plus the client quest.check; the worker owns the transitions.
topConcern: Worker's objective refusal returns without _questRefusedEcho (spec says every refusal echoes), so a predicted hand-in stands under v2.

title: Life-skill new level-up dot (seen levels per browser)
oneLine: localStorage per-skill seen level decides the Skills dot; the Skills page marks all seen on mount.
topConcern: A skill with no stamp counts as seen and nothing seeds the map, so a fresh browser never shows the dot before a first visit.

title: Scroll-tap gesture recovery
oneLine: Per-component gesture record replaying a browser-cancelled touch as a tap when nothing scrolled and travel is under 44 px.
topConcern: Any non-scroll pointercancel (long-press callout) also replays as a tap, e.g. arming the points reset.

title: Stat caption whole/short with cut hysteresis
oneLine: Caption shows the whole stat name or its short form, remembering widths where the browser cut it.
topConcern: A cut seen in the fallback font is remembered after the web font loads.

title: Points tab lane shown (picked versus held weapon) and dead lane state
oneLine: buildCat = a picked lane, cleared when the held weapon's lane changes; laneClosed/selCat/catCard sit beside it unused.
topConcern: laneClosed stuck true and selCat/catCard/catGrid unreachable but still computed; rewiring revives code unrun since v2.3.2683.

title: Hero view state: section tab, selected slot, open stat family
oneLine: Module-persisted section (reset on bar) and stat family (never reset), plus the selected gear slot.
topConcern: _lastFam survives every close, so later visits open with a family covering the character, unlike the section.

title: Spend points and stay: batch prog3_allocate and the waiting window
oneLine: Confirm window sends n allocations, shows Spending, waits for the echo or 3 s, reopens with what landed.
topConcern: Each point is an unpaced full blob save plus full player_state on the worker; one tap can be dozens of puts under nostatcap.

title: Free points reset two-tap arm
oneLine: First tap arms for 4 s, second sends points_reset through a helper with its own dedupe stamp.

title: Stat explainer scene loop (Now and +n on one clock)
oneLine: Timeline of id-guarded steps on setTimeouts, re-run on fresh dice, fully cleared on unmount or input change.
topConcern: Restarts from t=0 each time an async asset lands (up to four times in the first second).

title: Stat scene asset pipeline (figure, attack, moves, pins, films)
oneLine: Staged async captures with null/false/ready conventions and live guards, freed with the window.

title: Slime pin strips and per-launch-point keyframes
oneLine: Strip pixels read once and kept; a pins set and injected style per launch point, never removed.
topConcern: About 1.8 MB of frame data kept for the session; a style and set per stage width (rotation, resize) never freed.

title: Stat scene fight simulation (worker phases mirrored)
oneLine: Pure discrete-event mirror of slime attacks, status ticks, guard drain and kills, held by statsim.test.
topConcern: Guard pass never shows a break; cannot happen within its two attacks today.

title: Points rule-set mode: legacy blob, prog3 and cap-gated variants
oneLine: Sheet branches on record shape plus eight caps flags set each state_sync; readers pick their own subsets.
topConcern: Eight flags read ad hoc across five files; a cap gap shows the legacy grid whose T2 spend applies and persists client-side.

title: Equipment slots view (worn, ghost, cape REMOVE)
oneLine: Six cells derived from the rpg echo, the localStorage gear store and the worker-fed cape catalog.
topConcern: A cosmetic-only chest or legs layer lights the cell with no stat piece behind it (documented).

title: Band footprint per layout mode
oneLine: Pure table from orientation, one band, computer column, folded and sheet kind to band height and world width.

title: Character figure canvas (Equipment tab, stat scene)
oneLine: Draw-on-change canvas keyed by a wardrobe revision and weapon identity, out-of-order draws dropped by __pseq.
topConcern: Never redrawn after a parked-tab canvas purge (TRAPS 250) and its 768 px canvases are never emptied; drawn twice per stat window.

title: Identity strip (retired)
oneLine: Who-am-I row with connection dot and XP strip; band branch returns null and the header branch has no caller.

title: Shared portrait handoff (portraitStore)
oneLine: One-value store the dashboard fills with your sequence-guarded bust; readers fall back through one chain.
